identity_marker: black rectangular eBags compression cube with a branded mesh top lid
continuity_anchors: on a flat white bedsheet under bright, even indoor bedroom lighting
video_goal: Demonstrate how to efficiently pack a carry-on suitcase by wrapping clothes into a bundle and compressing them inside an eBags compression cube.
single_prompt: An overhead view shows hands laying a pair of jeans completely flat on a flat white bedsheet under bright, even indoor bedroom lighting, smoothing out the wrinkles along the legs. The camera moves to a close-up as hands place a t-shirt flat on top of the jeans, aligning the collars and sleeves in opposite directions to form a cross shape. From an over-the-shoulder view, hands place a small, tightly rolled pouch of socks directly in the center of the layered clothes to act as the bundle's core. In a close-up, hands fold the sleeves and bottom hem of the t-shirt tightly over the central sock pouch, wrapping it completely. The hands then fold the legs of the jeans tightly over the wrapped t-shirt layer, creating a single, compact, solid clothing bundle. From an overhead view, hands open an empty black rectangular eBags compression cube with a branded mesh top lid, folding back the mesh top to reveal the interior. A first-person view shows hands lifting the completed clothing bundle and placing it snugly inside the open black rectangular eBags compression cube with a branded mesh top lid. In a close-up, fingers pull the main top zipper of the cube closed, securing the mesh lid over the clothing bundle. An extreme close-up focuses on fingers gripping the secondary outer compression zipper on the cube and pulling it along the side edge. The camera pulls back to a close-up as hands press down firmly on the top of the mesh cube while pulling the compression zipper all the way around, visibly flattening it. From an over-the-shoulder view, hands lift the flattened, compressed cube and place it into the open main compartment of a carry-on suitcase. Finally, an overhead view shows hands buckling the internal tie-down straps of the carry-on suitcase over the cube and pulling the strap tight.
